content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: synth-prober-eu1 failure_rate high (threshold 5% -> 24%); incident_id=INC-20260312-004
pagerduty: Page: synth-prober-eu1 | failure_rate > 10% | auto-page to oncall (rotation: Maya P)
Maya P: acked on PD. I'm taking primary. :wave:
Sam K: I'm around to help, ping me if you want me to take fallout comms.
Maya P: quick snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/synth/probes?panelId=7&orgId=1 -> saw failure spike at 11:07 UTC, simultaneous increase in probe latency and 502/504 counts
Maya P: hypothesis: prober runners in eu1 experiencing IO pressure, causing request timeouts -> probes report failures
Maya P: switching prober to reduced fanout now to mitigate impact
Maya P: command to reduce fanout:
```
kubectl -n synth patch deployment synth-prober --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/0/value","value":"50"}]'
```
Maya P: applying in 2m
pagerduty: Auto: Page acknowledged by Maya P (1m ago)
infra-bot: Noted a CPU steal spike on nodes eu1-prober-*-pool at 11:06:55 UTC. Possible noisy neighbor.
Sam K: can we mute the PD deduped alert while we investigate? It'll keep paging on duplicates
Maya P: yes, I'll mute for 15m for this rule. /pd mute synth-prober-eu1 15m
pagerduty: Command accepted: Mute synth-prober-eu1 for 15 minutes (muted_by=Maya P)
Diego: adding temporary backoff on runner side; increasing probe interval from 30s -> 90s until stable
Maya P: backoff applied. watching failure rate drop. current failure rate 14% -> 7% after fanout/backoff
Maya P: starting customer-impact check: hitting internal mapping, looks like <1% customer-facing requests route through synth path; no active user-reported errors yet but we've seen a small upward trend in embed ingestion timeouts
Priya R: I'll draft a short note for SRE status page if we still see elevated failures at 12:00 UTC. assigning comms
Nina O: oncall handoff planned at 12:15 UTC; if incident still active, handoff to Priya R
Maya P: summary so far: mitigations applied: reduced fanout, increased backoff, muted noisy alerts. Fail rate trending down to 3.2% over 5m window
infra-bot: Created infra investigation ticket INF-7893: investigate eu1-prober node IO; assigned to Diego
Diego: I'm pulling runner logs: observed repeated liveness restarts for container id c7a3f2; raising potential kernel OOM-kill vs disk throttle
Sam K: if it looks like node-level IO, can we shift prober pods to eu1-prober-aux to spread load? kubectl cordon and recreate maybe
Maya P: prepping cordon/drain plan now, will coordinate with infra
Maya P: oncall handoff: I'm going to hand primary to Priya R at 12:15 UTC unless we need a longer warmfix
Priya R: acked the handoff, I'll be primary after 12:15 UTC. I'll keep the status page draft ready
Maya P: leaving runbook notes:
- actions performed: reduced fanout, increased probers backoff, muted PD rule 15m, created INF ticket
- next steps: cordon noisy nodes, collect dmesg + iostat, consider kernel tuning or rolling nodes
Maya P: logs snippet (truncated):
```
[11:06:58] prober: request timeout, ctx canceled
[11:06:59] node: iomgr: throttle detected on /dev/nvme0n1
[11:07:01] container c7a3f2: OOM? restarting
```
Priya R: if we end up doing node restarts, coordinate maintenance window with SRE rotation; I'll handle comms
Maya P: current status: degraded -> controlled; last failure rate check 11:28 UTC = 3.2% (5m), no customer reports
Priya R: updating status page: "Investigating elevated synthetic probe failures affecting eu1. Mitigations applied; no widespread customer impact observed."
pagerduty: Incident INC-20260312-004 status changed: acknowledged -> monitoring
Maya P: I'll close the alert in 20m if stable. leaving thread notes for follow-up
Priya R: thanks all. tagging infra for follow-up root-cause triage. :pray:
infra-bot: INF-7893 updated with logs and node metrics. follow-ups assigned.
Maya P: handing off. /me drops primary. Priya R, you're live.
Priya R: taking over. please DM if anything spikes. :phone:
